info.name: NFON Call History Accounts Customer Extensions API

items.docs: Creates a new callforward profile for a phone extension. A maximum of 10 profiles per extension is allowed. Profile number must be in the range 0-9 and must be unique within the extension. Profile name must be unique within the extension. The name 'Default' is reserved for profile 0 and cannot be used for other profiles. A new profile cannot be created with active=false.

Updates the callforward profile of a phone extension. The default profile (profileNumber=0) cannot be modified: its name and number are immutable. However, the API is resilient to idempotent requests — sending the current unchanged values for the default profile will succeed with 204 (no-op). Any attempt to actually change the default profile's name or number will be rejected with 400.
Deletes a callforward profile of a phone extension. The default profile (profileNumber=0) cannot be deleted. An active profile cannot be deleted — deactivate it first by activating another profile.
